thread:
frank: Quick sync for Comet Gala webinar (June 22). Need X/LinkedIn plan + 2 short threads: 1) benchmark-first, 2) demo-first. Also a 20s clip for X and hero static + small animated badge. Schedule: June 12 teaser, June 18 bench thread, June 21 reminder, June 22 live.

anya: I'll own the demo clip edit. Need timestamps for highlights by Tue.

luke: I'll set up A/B test on X CTA (Register vs Save your seat). Track CTR + signups.

maria: assets: can deliver hero static + badge gif by Wed EOD. Need final headline and 1-line CTA.

kevin: Copy drafts: X teaser: "Comet Gala: 2x throughput, 30% lower token cost. Demo + numbers June 22. Register -> {shortlink}" Bench thread: 3 tweets - headline+CTA, numbers+microchart, quick note on quantization + raw link. LI long: problem->approach->result->webinar CTA + customer quote.

luke: For routing: HubSpot form fields: company_size, role, region, interest_bench, interest_demo. Rule: company_size>500 OR lead_score>80 -> SDR queue immediate. Else nurture 4-email cadence.

frank: sdr-bot, can you set reminder 72h before copy freeze?

sdr-bot: Reminder set : Copy freeze in 72 hours (at 4971169200).

anya: Demo clip notes: show p99 comparison overlay at 0:06, highlight KV cache effect at 0:12. Keep captions on.

maria: I'll export microchart at 1200x675 and a tweet-sized PNG. Also include alt-text.

kevin: We should include an engagement follow-up: anyone who replies to the X thread -> auto DM with on-demand link + tag for SDR. Luke, you'll handle webhook?

luke: yes, will wire webhook to raise an internal alert channel #sd-threads and create a HubSpot note.

frank: one more: run a tiny experiment on copy variant for LI opener (customer quote vs stat lead). Track clicks+registrations.

maria: uploading assets to /marketing/assets/comet_gala by Wed. filenames: comet_hero_card.png, comet_badge.gif, demo_clip_v1.mp4, microchart_tweet.png.

kevin: I'll drop final copy into /marketing/copy/comet_gala by Mon noon. Everyone review by Tue.

frank: Great. Final checklist: assets uploaded, form mapping done, SDR rota ready for 48h post-event, A/B tests set. Thanks :sparkles:
